item.title: Outside 102-94 Cholmley gardens, 17th November
item.description:
Drain is block NOT with leaves but rubble from the road resurfacing work in August. I reported this 7th August 2026 while the parking restriction was still in place so the drain could be accessed. The report looks to have been closed with no corrective action taken. Blocked drains on fortune green railing flooding outside the fire station and Waitrose. This flood water runs down Weat cottages resulting in flooding to properties. This has happened many times and has resulted in £20k of damages. Please take action to unblock this drain and all the others that are blocked on Fortune Green Road following the resurface works. This is not just seasonal leaf blockages.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Fortune Green Road, West Hampstead, Greater London
